text:
Marta: Quick flag 1: our SDKs currently surface a single opaque `APIError` object. Customers can't reliably decide whether to retry, reauth, or show an explanatory UI. We should standardize a tiny typed surface + stable envelope.

Sam: Strong yes. Minimal types: AuthError, RateLimitError, ValidationError, SafetyReject, TransientServerError. Core envelope fields: `code` (machine id), `message` (user-friendly), `retryable` (bool), `retry_after` (secs opt), `hint` (short actionable text), `internal_error_id` (support lookup), `signal` (for Console grouping).

Priya: Parity note: python returns subclasses now; JS uses a single class with stringy codes; Go uses wrapped errors. We should land a compatibility plan:
- JS: set `err.name`, `err.code`, `err.retryable` so callers can inspect properties instead of parsing message.
- Go: expose typed errors implementing `IsRetryable() bool` and `Code() string`.
- Python: keep subclasses but ensure `code` attr exists for uniformity.

Leo: UX/sampleapp idea: ship a tiny component library that demonstrates handling:
- AuthError -> show CTA "Reconnect account" and log `internal_error_id` to support panel.
- RateLimitError -> display countdown using `retry_after` and copy from shared strings.
- ValidationError -> highlight the bad fields, show `hint` with fix steps.
- SafetyReject -> show neutral message and contact support with `internal_error_id`.

Marta: Two principles to bake in: 1) never expose raw stack traces to end users; only show `internal_error_id` and friendly `message`. 2) treat the envelope as stable contract1 clients should not rely on parsing freeform `message`.

Sam: Also recommend `telemetry_signal` (`quota_exceeded`, `auth_expired`, `safety_block`) for Console auto-grouping and helpful dashboard suggestions.

Priya: I'll add parity unit tests to each SDK repo that assert the presence and types of these fields. Add a small CI job that runs sampleapp smoke tests that exercise each flow.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-599: "SDK error contract + sampleapp + parity tests" and attached this thread.

Marta: Thanks. Can we sync tomorrow to pick exact copy strings for `hint` and the shared copy resource path? @Sam @Priya please drop PR links in DEVEX-599 when ready. :thumbsup:
